patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Salesloft's shape. Choose Salesloft only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, seque” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans data-enrichment; Salesloft leans sales-engagement. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Salesloft share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Salesloft is Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM sync, sequencing, coaching; talk-to-sales pricing..
- Company-size focus: Clay (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Salesloft (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning data-enrichment vs Salesloft-leaning sales-engagement.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Salesloft — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Salesloft: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — talk-to-sales only.

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Salesloft is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Clay if you actually need Salesloft's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / revenue generation platform — bi-directional CRM s)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
